mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follows (follower_id, followee_id) VALUES (#{followerId}, #{followeeId}) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uq_follows_follower_followee DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM follows WHERE follower_id = #{followerId} AND followee_id = #{followeeId}
mapper.sql: u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.avatar_url, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follows f2 WHERE f2.follower_id = #{currentUserId} AND f2.followee_id = u.id ) AS followed_by_me
mapper.select: SELECT FROM follows f JOIN users u ON u.id = f.follower_id WHERE f.followee_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.id DESC LIMIT 500
